message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a red border on the left and bottom. At the top, large red letters spell "TEMPO." Smaller red text below reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." Black text at the top left reads "PENGAKUAN PENUSUKWIRANTO," and at the top right, "BURSA DIREKTUR UTAMA BANK MANDIRI."

Large white, italicized block letters in the center state "PARTAI KETINGGALAN KERETA." Below this, smaller white text begins with "Berniat membangun koalisi gemuk..."

The central image depicts four men in suits at a train station. They are running towards the right side of the frame, where the rear of a blue and grey train car is visible. The man in front wears a dark suit, carries a brown rectangular briefcase, and reaches his hand toward the departing train. Behind him, another man in a dark suit runs. A third man wears a reddish-brown jacket, and a fourth man on the far left wears a tan coat. All are shown in profile or from the back, in motion.

In the bottom right corner, white text includes "4-10 NOVEMBER 2019," price "RP 45.000," and a barcode with "00037" above it.
